html:
After months of preparation, on March 1 we took a new client live on Google AdWords. After 2 weeks, they called us and asked us to almost double the budget. 

According to the business manager, this business had already made enough money to cover their AdWords expense. To him, it was clear to see they had been wasting years and tons of money on Yellow Pages.  For years, YP.COM had been spending some money on AdWords with very little results and no transparency to what they were doing or what it cost.

Related: 5 Costly Mistakes When Using Google Adwords - And How To Avoid Making Them

What we did:

  1. Redesigned the website to cearly target 3 specific niches
  2. Added more contact forms & call now buttons throughout the website
  3. Created targeted AdWords campaigns for each of their 3 specific niches with 3-5 adgroups in each
  4. Created simple landing pages for each of their 3 specific niches
  5. Set up conversion tracking in Analytics & AdWords
  6. Set up remarketing lists in Analytics
  7. Created 1 remarketing campaign
We are AdWords Certified. Learn More about Broadstreet Consulting's AdWords services

The fact is, no matter how great your AdWords campaign may be set up, it will not perform if your landing page looks confusing and cluttered.

We have the expertise to not only optimize your Google AdWords marketing strategies, but to also optimize your website. Your website is the basis for all online marketing strategies. Every single thing you promote will bring the customer back to your website, and if it's not mobile-friendly, easy to navigate, with a clear call-to-action, you're going to be missing out on a lot of business.
